scientific.integrity: The GaLore project-update-project-back recurrence is solved exactly on an isotropic diagonal matrix quadratic. Each refreshed top singular subspace is unique, the unit projected step annihilates it, and projector reuse then gives an exact zero compact gradient until the next refresh.
limitations: Plain SGD base optimizer rather than Adam.
Unit step chosen for exact block annihilation.
Diagonal strictly ordered initialization with m divisible by r.
Worst-case deterministic diagnostic rather than practical stochastic training.

title: GaLore can spend an entire refresh block blind to the current gradient
